scope: GH-S07 selected V02 unboxed disc rail
standard-width centred composition and reduced disc scale
page composition adjacency and responsive reflow

T1Distinctiveness.evidence: At 1280px and 375px with all material stripped to charcoal and the page greyscaled, the hard circular family, exact centred Wings, open equal rail and asymmetric editorial header remain recognisably Mez.

T2Repetition.evidence: The page sequence remains hero mosaic, testimonial rail, problem field, architecture diagram, workflow sequence, sticky proof, authored dark split and product mosaic. GH-S07 does not repeat an adjacent family.

T3MotionTruth.evidence: The tightened candidate produced 146 WebGL draw calls over 1.2 seconds with exactly one ecosystem canvas live. The preceding motion proof also measured 45.61% pixel change, confirmed single-host switching from MZ-G12 to MZ-G06, and returned ecosystem hosts and canvases to zero on blur; only layout CSS changed after that proof.

T4ProductTruth.evidence: The rail uses the four canonical coming-soon names, MZ-G12, MZ-G06, MZ-G15 and MZ-G20, their exact static twins, the shared renderer and canonical Wings. No placeholder or invented product data appears.

responsiveReview.evidence: No horizontal overflow was observed. The rail is held to the standard 1160px shell; discs resolve to 88px at 320–390, 116px at 768–920, 147px at 1280 and the selected 164px cap at 1440. At desktop every disc and copy centre matches its column centre; the four-column rail becomes two centred columns and then a compact source-ordered vertical list.

fallbackReview.evidence: Forced-static and no-WebGL states keep the exact MZ-G12 twin, a 1:1 147px disc at 1280 and zero canvases or live hosts after focus.

canonSweep.method: Rendered normal, compact, stripped, live, forced-static and no-WebGL states; checked COL, TYP, LAY, MOT, ICO, CPY and MAT in ID order. The gate would fail on a restored dark tray, card chassis, non-circular field, second live core, missing static twin, off-token focus, horizontal overflow or invented product truth.

recommendation.reason: The standard-width rail and smaller centred product stacks preserve the unboxed expression Olli selected while removing the scattered feel of the earlier wide composition.
